rules: Re-audit the exact review against the exact memory; do not trust a supplied PASS report alone.
Require the TaskEpisode to be canonically admitted, outcome SUCCESS, and atom/context-identical to the review target.
Require the candidate source obstruction/domain to equal the target obstruction/domain and require candidate authority PROPOSAL_ONLY.
Require lineage to account for the target TaskEpisode, review, and every selected source episode; for LIFT also account for the missing-transformation specification.
Mint at most VERIFIED_LOCAL structural-memory authority in v1; never PROOF_BACKED, scientific authority, lesson authority or ResearchTool authority.
Recompute the promoted structural episode artifact hash from exact content; caller hash cannot survive promotion unchanged.
Append a new promoted episode id while leaving the proposal candidate and all negative history immutable outside the returned memory view.
